# Upload to GitHub

Preferred: unzip this archive on a computer, `git clone https://github.com/WackyWaldo90/RE3-N64-Port.git`, copy the **contents** of this workspace into the clone, then `git add . && git commit -m "Import RE3 Codex workspace" && git push`.

On Android, extract with Files/ZArchiver, then use a Git client or GitHub web upload. GitHub web upload is awkward for many files; do not upload only the ZIP if Codex needs to edit its contents.

If a ChatGPT GitHub connector returns 403, configure the GitHub App's repository access and Contents write permission.
